ucs.title: [LLM] Akira pre-encryption recovery sabotage (Win32_Shadowcopy WMI deletion + boot-recovery disable)
ucs.description: Hunts Akira's (a.k.a. GOLD SAHARA / PUNK SPIDER / Howling Scorpius) characteristic recovery-inhibition step that immediately precedes T1486 deployment: a PowerShell one-liner enumerating and removing Volume Shadow Copies via WMI (`Get-WmiObject Win32_Shadowcopy | Remove-WmiObject`) alongside vssadmin/bcdedit recovery tampering. This combination is a hallmark of Akira affiliate playbooks documented by CrowdStrike and the FBI/CISA #StopRansomware:Akira advisory.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=t allow_old_summaries=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as process values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent_process_name from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wmic.exe","vssadmin.exe","wbadmin.exe","bcdedit.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| where match(process,"(?i)(win32_shadowcopy|remove-wmiobject|delete\s+shadows|delete\s+catalog|recoveryenabled\s+no|bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures|resize\s+shadowstorage)")
| where NOT match(user,"(?i)\$$")
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| table firstTime lastTime dest user process_name parent_process_name process count
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wmic.exe","vssadmin.exe","wbadmin.exe","bcdedit.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Win32_Shadowcopy","Remove-WmiObject","delete shadows","delete catalog","recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures","resize shadowstorage")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName has_any ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wmic.exe","vssadmin.exe","wbadmin.exe","bcdedit.exe")
| where CommandLine has_any ("Win32_Shadowcopy","Remove-WmiObject","delete shadows","delete catalog","recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures","resize shadowstorage")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Akira-style Shadow Copy Deletion and Recovery Tampering
id: 6f2c1a9e-7b3d-4e8a-9c1f-akira01shadow
status: experimental
description: Detects Akira ransomware pre-encryption recovery inhibition via WMI shadow copy deletion and bcdedit/vssadmin recovery tampering
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\wmic.exe'
      - '\vssadmin.exe'
      - '\wbadmin.exe'
      - '\bcdedit.exe'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'Win32_Shadowcopy'
      - 'Remove-WmiObject'
      - 'delete shadows'
      - 'delete catalog'
      - 'recoveryenabled no'
      - 'bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures'
      - 'resize shadowstorage'
  condition: selection_img and selection_cmd
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate backup software performing shadow storage maintenance
level: high
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.t1489
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\cmd.exe OR *\wmic.exe OR *\WMIC.exe OR *\vssadmin.exe OR *\VSSAdmin.exe OR *\bcdedit.exe OR *\BCDEdit.exe) @CommandLine:(*Win32_Shadowcopy* OR *win32_shadowcopy* OR *Remove-WmiObject* OR *"delete shadows"* OR *"delete catalog"* OR *recoveryenabled* OR *"resize shadowstorage"*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/(powershell|pwsh|cmd|wmic|vssadmin|wbadmin|bcdedit)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(Win32_Shadowcopy|Remove-WmiObject|delete\\s+shadows|delete\\s+catalog|recoveryenabled\\s+no|bootstatuspolicy\\s+ignoreallfailures|resize\\s+shadowstorage)", field=CommandLine)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())

ucs.title: [LLM] Akira actions-on-objective: legitimate remote-access tooling co-resident with Rclone/WinSCP cloud exfil
ucs.description: Surfaces the same host running an Akira-favored remote-access utility (AnyDesk, RustDesk, Cloudflared tunnel, LogMeIn, ngrok) and a bulk-exfiltration tool (Rclone, WinSCP, FileZilla) staging data to cloud storage (MEGA/S3/B2) within a short window — Akira's documented double-extortion staging chain (GOLD SAHARA / Howling Scorpius) after VPN-based valid-account access.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=t allow_old_summaries=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmds values(Processes.process_name) as procs from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("rclone.exe","winscp.exe","winscp.com","filezilla.exe","anydesk.exe","rustdesk.exe","cloudflared.exe","logmein.exe","ngrok.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| eval procstr=mvjoin(procs,",")
| eval has_exfil=if(match(procstr,"(?i)(rclone|winscp|filezilla)"),1,0)
| eval has_ra=if(match(procstr,"(?i)(anydesk|rustdesk|cloudflared|logmein|ngrok)"),1,0)
| where has_exfil=1 AND has_ra=1
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| table firstTime lastTime dest user procs cmds count
ucs.kql:
let Window = 1d;
let RemoteAccess = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(14d)
    | where FileName has_any ("anydesk.exe","rustdesk.exe","cloudflared.exe","logmein.exe","ngrok.exe","screenconnect")
    | project RaTime = Timestamp, DeviceName, RaTool = FileName, RaCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where FileName in~ ("rclone.exe","winscp.exe","winscp.com","filezilla.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("mega","b2:","s3:","copy ","sync ","--multi-thread","--transfers","sftp","ftp","--config")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| join kind=inner RemoteAccess on DeviceName
| where RaTime between (Timestamp - Window .. Timestamp + Window)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, ExfilTool = FileName, ProcessCommandLine, RaTool, RaCmd, RaTime
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let Window = 1d;
let RemoteAccess = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName has_any ("anydesk.exe","rustdesk.exe","cloudflared.exe","logmein.exe","ngrok.exe","screenconnect")
    | project RaTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, RaTool = NewProcessName, RaCmd = CommandLine;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName has_any ("rclone.exe","winscp.exe","winscp.com","filezilla.exe")
| where CommandLine has_any ("mega","b2:","s3:","copy ","sync ","--multi-thread","--transfers","sftp","ftp","--config")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| join kind=inner RemoteAccess on Computer
| where RaTime between (TimeGenerated - Window .. TimeGenerated + Window)
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ExfilTool = NewProcessName, CommandLine, RaTool, RaCmd, RaTime
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\rclone.exe OR *\Rclone.exe OR *\winscp.exe OR *\WinSCP.exe OR *\filezilla.exe OR *\FileZilla.exe OR *\anydesk.exe OR *\AnyDesk.exe OR *\rustdesk.exe OR *\RustDesk.exe OR *\cloudflared.exe OR *\Cloudflared.exe OR *\logmein.exe OR *\LogMeIn.exe OR *\ngrok.exe)
ucs.rationale: Each tool alone is dual-use (IT teams legitimately run AnyDesk, admins use WinSCP), so a single-tool rule is a dashboard.
